items.title: Trump Bans Anthropic AI in Federal Agencies — Pentagon Flags Claude as Security Risk
items.description: The U.S. government has taken unprecedented action against domestic AI firm Anthropic, directing all federal agencies to immediately stop using its AI model Claude and officially designating the company a supply chain risk to national security, a classification historically reserved for foreign adversaries like Huawei. The standoff reached a critical point on February 28, 2026, […] The post…
